name: Shift-Click Issue Filer
description: Hold Shift and click any element to capture it — with a screenshot, DOM path, Rails view/partial chain, controller and key computed styles. Stack elements across pages, then file them as an issue or copy them onto a mood board in any of your workspace accounts.

toggle-inspector.description: Toggle the shift-click issue inspector on/off

toggle-review-bar.description: Toggle the review bar (mark up & comments) on/off

toggle-tagger.description: Tag an element as the component@variant it must render
